name: Disney Streaming Edge
notes:
## Disney Streaming Edge

Disney Streaming Services Edge (DSS Edge) is now offering first party capabilities to connect directly to your network from AS23344. 

If you’re interested in peering with us, please provide additional details via [this form](https://airtable.com/appiIOZp7X24pq14v/pagx3nOWeiDTwRMdt/form). Please send all peering requests via this form. 

## Disney Distribution Network

Disney Streaming Services is evaluating partners for a future distribution network that will include commercial CDNs, Open Caches, and Disney cache appliances that are initially planned to be deployed at IXPs.

Cache appliances are not generally available today. 

If you are interested in deploying a cache appliance into your network in the future, please fill out [this form](https://airtable.com/appiIOZp7X24pq14v/pagx3nOWeiDTwRMdt/form) to register your interest. We will reach out to select networks once the cache appliances become generally available.


## Open Cache Framework

We are also open to participating with ISP Caches that are compliant with the [Open Cache framework](https://opencaching.svta.org/).
